segments.text: But I've seen them becoming a better human being, less attached to the worldly life.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So I think that's the result of the practice.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So I think the problem is, if you can look at it as a challenge, being a Buddhist practitioner, not much fear.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And of course, being most important, not much hope and fear.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Rinpoche, thank you so much for sharing the Dharma with us tonight.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
